caveat: The 0.5%-per-group tolerance was chosen after inspecting this source validation, so this replay is post-hoc and not independent. Source clean waveform is a training and quality reference, not an inference input. Source IDs overlap earlier selector experiments, so this is exploratory. Only the regressor uses receiver/day holdout; the frozen models saw source data. Simulator is not validated real satellite data; previously observed Phase1 development-test results motivated exploration.
